programs.name: Fluid Run
programs.description: v1.7.6 phone app for the daily fluid run. Setup has Add history days, a merge-only import that adds missing dates from a file or a one-tap link and never changes days already on the phone or shared live records. History has a Weekly copy view: pick a Monday–Sunday week and Children's, POW, or both, then Copy or Share a short WhatsApp-ready list of delivered fluids per day and ward (for example 2544 × 6 box, 1323 × 5 EA). Empty days and wards are skipped; an optional weekly total per code is off by default. Fluids with no par at a hospital sit in a greyed, collapsed “Not used at …” group at the bottom of Stock and the ward Codes picker, with Bring back if you need one; favourites and quick-taps stay visible but greyed. Children’s 0164 is marked New – first order on the next Children’s order (its par is not changed). If on hand is at or below half of par, the item is flagged in amber as “Order – half par or less” and the Order tab pre-fills a top-up to par in whole boxes; items below par but above half are not flagged or auto-ordered. The earlier red 5-box highlight is gone. A quantity you type by hand is kept if a suggestion later changes. The Stock tab has separate POW and Children’s sections, each with On hand, Redo stocktake and Par stock (the amount needed in storage per fluid, in whole boxes, per hospital). Code tiles on each ward stay in a tight three-column grid on a phone, with long names clipped and the favourite star inside the tile. The Codes / Notes tabs and the search bar stick just below the header when you scroll. Each ward’s fluid picker has a search bar under the ward name (type a code or name, including AHB-style codes). The ward screen opens on a Codes tab so the grid is visible straight away; Notes / Done holds the private note, Nothing needed and Mark done. The Trolleys tab has a sticky, sideways-scrolling row of ward-name chips that jump to each ward, and Load trolley is grouped by ward in round order, with quantity and unit, a tick to mark an item loaded, and a ward-level all-loaded tick. Barcode links sync between phones when the shared table is on. A Missing barcode list, dated close-out history, close-out vs par order text (copy for WhatsApp, not sent), ward quick-taps, weekly spot-check, haptic feedback, per-ward progress and a daily streak are included. Shared day, week and stock records (no login — anyone with the link can see them); each phone still works offline. The Stock tab shows remaining stock as boxes plus loose packets. Set a par in whole boxes per hospital and item on the Stock tab (shared). Quantities stay editable, boxes only; WhatsApp is in boxes. Stocktake converts box and each deliveries to one packet total using packets per box, and remaining stock is shown as boxes plus loose packets. Entering a fluid on a ward deducts it from on hand immediately. Remaining stock carries over as the next day’s starting stocktake. AHB6028 stays at 12 packets per box. The fluid list shows 2B7231 as 2B7231 (slosh). History can print or download Excel by day, week or month, including today. Weekly summary, History and Excel show packets (ea) and the box equivalent side by side, per ward per item. Add a ward from the Round list; it stays for every future day. Each ward’s fluid list has search-as-you-type, type headings, and a Favourites row (most-used from that hospital’s own history, plus stars you save). The lists stay compact. First open is a Gerardo / Prabin / Guest picker. A confirm warning appears before live changes, except for Prabin in POW and Gerardo in Children’s; Guest always sees it.
